DebugAlgo needs a debugger with embedded: DebugAlgo needs a debugger with embedded Python, and the one in this session has none. Use CodeLLDB, which bundles its own LLDB and Python, or a GDB built with Python (on Windows, mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-gdb from MSYS2 UCRT64).
DebugAlgo injected Python into the debug: DebugAlgo injected Python into the debugger and nothing was written to disk. The two possible causes are a debugger without embedded Python and a file path that did not survive the debugger console. Check that GDB has Python (gdb --configuration) and that the system temporary folder is writable.
